name: Pink Princess
summary: Pink Princess is an aesthetic that empathizes girlish innocence, elegance, compassion, and living a life of pleasure and luxury.
description:
Pink Princess is an aesthetic that empathizes girlish innocence, elegance, compassion, and living a life of pleasure and luxury. Although it burrows elements from different time periods, the aesthetic mostly uses imagery inspired by the Rococo era due to Marie Antionette and the era's fashion and lifestyle being used for inspiration. It can be considered as a sub-aesthetic to Princesscore , as they are both visually and thematically similar. However, while Princesscore is about the fantasy of being a royal princess, Pink Princess is more centered around upper-class life.

Visually, the style is very similar to Romantic Academia , although it is not an academic aesthetic. Pink Parisian also has a significant influence on Pink Princess. The color palette is heavy on pink tones combined with gold, white, or other pastel colors. Silver is sometimes used, but is much less common than gold.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Self-love, kindness, compassion, generosity
